text: A path in cubical type theory between a and b in type A is:
choices: an element of the identity type a = b
a function p: I → A with p(i0) = a and p(i1) = b
a homotopy between a and b
a proof of a ≡ b (definitional equality)
explanation: Cubical paths are functions from the interval: PathP (λ_. A) a b ≡ Π(i:I). A with the constraint that the function reduces to a at i0 and b at i1.
